messages:
mike: hey all, day 3 here. trying to fetch secrets for my sandbox but getting 403 from vault.redwood.ai. i followed the okta steps — any quick checklist? :wave:

devex: welcome @mike! can you confirm you completed the "Onboard: tooling" Okta app and that your manager approved your new-hire access request? most 403s are missing group mappings.

mike: yep okta app is connected and manager approval is in the onboarding doc. tried `rwdx secrets auth login` and it fails.

sec: @mike two quick things to confirm: 1) did you select the correct project scope in the request (sandbox vs org-wide)? 2) are you on the corporate VPN or in a private network that blocks our proxy?

mike: project scope was "sandbox-team-alpha". i'm on home wifi but company VPN is connected.

devex: if scope is correct and VPN is active then it's likely the request hasn't been approved yet or the role mapping failed. open a ticket at https://secrets.redwood.internal/request (choose "new-hire dev access") and paste the ticket link here. we can escalate to approvals team.

build-bot: Created ticket S-51200 for mike (new-hire dev access)  assigned: devex.eta:4h.

anya: FYI: for local dev we encourage using short-lived DB creds via the DB proxy instead of storing DB_URL. command: `rwdx db temp-user --role dev --ttl 4h` returns JSON creds you can export. also CI should use KMS aliases `kms:alias/redwood/ci` not raw secrets.

mike: thanks. small followup: what's the standard rotation cadence? and who owns rotation if i'm developing a feature that needs a new secret?

sec: rotation policy quick summary: app secrets 90 days, infra/KMS keys yearly auto-rotate. Owners (service or repo owners) are responsible for triggering app-level rotations via the portal and updating clients. if there's an urgent compromise, file an incident in #incidents and security will coordinate a rekey.

devex: once your ticket is approved run: ```
# authenticate with proxy
rwdx secrets auth login
# verify a key
rwdx secrets kv get path=teams/sandbox-team-alpha/CONFIG
```
if that still errors post the CLI output (redact tokens) and we'll debug.

mike: ticket S-51200 shows in-progress. i'll try the CLI after approval and report back. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
